properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: ECDSA capability shipped by the build. twisted.conch exercises `cryptography` for SSH key parsing; no direct ECDSA call in application code — available in the shipped library, no call site found in tron itself.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: password-KDF capability shipped with Werkzeug (2.2.3). No direct werkzeug.security use in tron's own code. Note: the build ALSO declares py-bcrypt==0.4 (requirements.txt:45) which the deterministic scan missed entirely — reported as a new finding.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: X.509 handling (cert parsing, CSR, CRL) ships with the build; exercised indirectly by the TLS stack (urllib3 1.25.10/requests 2.27.1) and twisted conch. No direct X.509 API call in application code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: CA trust anchor for all outbound TLS: requests/urllib3 use certifi's Mozilla bundle, e.g. the authorization calls in tron/api/auth.py:34 posting bearer tokens to API_AUTH_ENDPOINT. Bundle roots are classical RSA/ECDSA CA keys — a deadline (not harvesting) PQ exposure.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: CA trust bundle provider; rides the requests/urllib3 TLS stack for all outbound HTTPS (auth endpoint calls in tron/api/auth.py). Version pinned 2022.12.7 — bundle freshness is a governance item.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Available in the shipped library; no call site found in the application. 2018-era release of a pure-Python, timing-sensitive ECDSA implementation — worth upgrading regardless of PQ posture (Shor-vulnerable primitive, deadline risk).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Available in the shipped library; no direct import in tron code. requirements-minimal.txt:24 explains it exists as a vault-tools dependency and for Twisted import paths — i.e. it is there to support the Vault-based auth tooling, not tron's own calls.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The crypto core of the build: twisted.conch uses it for SSH key handling on every node connection (tron/ssh.py), and urllib3/requests/pyopenssl ride its OpenSSL bindings. Version 41.0.5 (2023) predates ML-KEM support (cryptography added hybrid PQ KEM only in later releases against OpenSSL 3.5).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Shipped RSA signing primitive with no direct call site in tron code — it exists to serve google-auth's RS256 JWT signing for the kubernetes client stack (kubernetes==26.1.0 -> google-auth==1.23.0 -> rsa). Reported as its own new finding for the RS256 signing capability google-auth provides.
